text: In February 2021, residents reached out to my office with an urgent concern about speeding on the north-south segment of Cosmo Nature Lane near Susan Tibaldi Parkette. In November of last year, residents requested via petition that traffic calming measures (speed bumps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. Of the residents that responded, there was unanimous support for making this change. I am requesting that speed bumps be installed on Cosmos Nature Lane.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in Cosmos Nature Lane, bounded by Bloor Street West, Margueretta Street, Wallace Avenue and Brock Avenue, as shown on Drawing 421G-3992, dated February 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
